scope: Targeted setting corrections, not a claim that every resort fact or offer is verified. Geographic labels describe a property; All-Inclusive requires a documented overnight product. Fishing ponds, lagoons, pools and heated jacuzzis alone do not establish Lake or Hot Spring resorts. No accreditation, coordinates, prices or planner limits are changed.

corrections.name: Aguakan Resort
corrections.reason: Government water-resource documentation identifies Aguacan Inland Resort's swimming water as cold springs. A town's mountain backdrop does not establish a mountain resort. Cold Spring is not currently an available setting, so retain the supported Inland label without substituting Hot Spring.

corrections.name: Montefrio Garden Resort
corrections.reason: The operator locates the resort in Kapatagan's highlands and describes infinity pools and heated jacuzzis. Heating does not establish a natural geothermal spring; no qualifying spring was verified.

corrections.name: Discovery Samal
corrections.reason: The operator's current Tranquil Escape offer includes breakfast, transfers and discounts on dining, not inclusive full-board meals. Remove the unsupported blanket All-Inclusive label; this does not rule out a separately verified future package.

corrections.name: Eden Mountain Resort
corrections.reason: The operator describes Fishing Village as stocked ponds, with catch weighed and charged separately. That supports neither a lakeside setting nor an all-inclusive overnight product. Preserve the geographic Mountain/Inland labels.

corrections.name: Malagos Garden Resort
corrections.reason: The operator's published terms distinguish accommodation, breakfast and additional charges. Cafes and activities on a property are not proof that all meals/activities are included in its ordinary overnight rate. Retain Inland; remove unsupported All-Inclusive.

corrections.name: Dusit Thani Lubi Plantation Resort
corrections.reason: The operator confirms an island beachfront resort and publishes separate dining offers, credits and paid breakfast experiences. A general All-Inclusive overnight classification is not established; retain the supported Beach/Island settings.

corrections.name: D' Leonor Inland Resort & Adventure Park
corrections.reason: Official city tourism identifies an inland resort. A fishing village/amenity is insufficient evidence for a lakeside resort. No qualifying lake setting was verified, so remove Lake rather than infer it from fishing.

corrections.name: Hijo Resorts Davao
corrections.reason: TIEZA documents Banana Beach and a fishing village named The Spot within the wider plantation. A fishing amenity is not enough to classify the accommodation as Lake; a plantation containing inland features is not enough to promise a separate Inland resort product. Keep the directly documented Beach setting.

retained_all_inclusive.reason: The operator explicitly advertises an all-inclusive experience with overnight accommodation, full-board meals and transfers. Extra experiences can still cost more; classification is not a booking confirmation.

The documented exclusive-island overnight package includes accommodation, three meals and two snacks per day, boat transfers and listed leisure activities. It is a whole-island group package with advance booking, not an ordinary per-person walk-in room rate. Extras are not universally included.
